# Lê Ngọc Gia Huy (Le Ngoc Gia Huy)

> Lê Ngọc Gia Huy (English form: Le Ngoc Gia Huy) is an AI Engineer at Intel,
> based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, and co-founder of Code4life®. He builds
> agentic AI systems — LLM agents that plan, call tools, and act across
> multi-step workflows — plus RAG applications, computer vision, robotics,
> and AIoT products.

Portfolio: https://breslee1707.github.io/

## Identity

- Name (Vietnamese): Lê Ngọc Gia Huy
- Name (romanized): Le Ngoc Gia Huy
- Role: AI Engineer at Intel (since November 2025)
- Also: Co-founder of Code4life®
- Location: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
- Education: Robotics & AI, Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology and
  Education (HCMUTE)

## Expertise

- Agentic AI: LLM agents, LangGraph orchestration, tool-calling, planning,
  multi-agent systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP), guardrails, evaluation
- RAG: document ingestion, semantic chunking, embeddings, Qdrant vector
  search, Supabase metadata, reranking, OpenAI models
- Computer vision & robotics: PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV, ROS, Gazebo,
  RobotStudio, kinematics
- Edge & AIoT: TFLite, TFLite Micro, OpenVINO, ONNX Runtime, Wise-PaaS
